plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Build websites that look like a design studio made them: editorial serif typography, warm-neutral and near-black grounds, cinematic photography, layered scroll parallax and exploded technical views. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, a motion runtime, a section library, a scaffolder and an audit that fails the build on the usual tells.
